# `ContentRegistry::overlays`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-content">content</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **Content** (`src/plugins/content.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns every registered overlay descriptor by stable content id.

## Signature

```rust
fn overlays (& self) -> & BTreeMap < ContentId , OverlayContentDescriptor >
```

## Arguments

This method does not take plugin-supplied arguments.

## Return Value

& BTreeMap < [`ContentId`](../structures/contentid.md) , [`OverlayContentDescriptor`](../structures/overlaycontentdescriptor.md) >

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/contentregistry-overlays.md`](../../examples/methods/contentregistry-overlays.md)_

```rust
let overlays = registry.overlays();
assert!(overlays.values().any(|overlay| overlay.hotkey.starts_with('F')));
```
